text: Academic advisors are assigned to students based on a student’s major and last name (see Undergraduate Advisors below). Natural Sciences and Mathematics (NSM) Academic Advisors assist undergraduate students via UTD email, virtual appointments and in-person appointments. We recommend all undergraduate students meet with their academic advisor at least once per semester. Reasons to set-up an appointment include: Review degree progress audit and degree plan Discuss a semester by semester plan toward graduation Discuss change of major to NSM or within NSM Discuss adding a minor The NSM Advising Suite in Classroom Building (CB 1.101) will be open Monday through Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. and 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Only virtual appointments will be scheduled on Fridays.
source_title: School of Natural Sciences and Mathematics: Undergraduate Advising
